Short title and commencement

ACT XXIII OF 1975
ACT XXIII OF
1975
PAKISTAN COINAGE
(AMENDMENT) ACT, 1975
An Act further to
amend the Pakistan Coinage Act
[Gazette of
Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I, 20th February 1975]
The following Act of Parliament
received the assent of the President on
the 15th February 1975, and is hereby published for general
information:--
1. Short title and
commencement.----(1) This Act may be called the Pakistan Coinage
(Amendment) Act, 1975.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

General

Pakistan Coinage Act (III of 1906), hereinafter referred to as the said Act,
for the words "Central Government", wherever occurring, the words
"Federal Government" shall be substituted.
